newsitem.title: GERMANY: Turkish Airlines adds extra Berlin flights.
newsitem.headline: Turkish Airlines adds extra Berlin flights.

text.p: Turkish Airlines is adding three new flights between Berlin and Turkey, the Berlin airport authority said.
The first - a fifth weekly flight from Berlin Schoenefeld to Istanbul - was launched by the Turkish national carrier on June 3, a statement said.
Turkish Airlines will also start weekly flights to Berlin from Trabzon on June 10 and from Izmir on June 17, it added.

The airline will then fly a total of 11 weekly services from Berlin to Turkey, with five flights to Istanbul, three to Ankara and one to Trabzon, Izmir and Adana. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom. Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
